title: Gate evidence bundle (v0.8)
description: One readable JSON document binding per-stage in-toto-shaped Statement entries to content-addressed subjects at the bundle top level: the PR head commit plus one sha256 digest per ingested input file, optionally wrapped in a self-signed DSSE envelope. Contract v0.8 — v0 (LOCKED — resolution of TzolkinB/skills#102) plus an additive `EMPTY` execution result (TzolkinB/skills#111, v0.1, ADR-0031) plus the internal witness:// -> gate:// identifier rename (TzolkinB/skills#113, v0.2, ADR-0033) plus the proven -> confirmed taxonomy rename (TzolkinB/skills#126, v0.3, ADR-0034) plus per-input sha256 subjects binding the decision to the exact ingested bytes (TzolkinB/skills#139, v0.4, ADR-0037 §2) plus an OPTIONAL top-level `dsseEnvelope` — a self-signed ed25519 DSSE envelope over the bundle's `subject` + the gate entry's `predicate` (TzolkinB/skills#141, v0.5, ADR-0037 §1) plus, when signed, the DSSE payload ALSO digest-binds each parsed evidence entry and folds in `producedOn`/`schemaVersion` (TzolkinB/skills#158, v0.6, ADR-0040 — digest-bind-entries, not sign-all: entries ride in as content-addressed subjects, integrity not endorsement) plus an additive `rejected` boolean on a gate-predicate input (hostile-review finding #2, 2026-07-25 — a malformed/inconsistent audit-test-json emission now persists as its own distinct state instead of rendering identically to `absent`, v0.7, ADR-0042) plus an OPTIONAL `business-risk` entry (TzolkinB/skills#199, v0.8, ADR-0045) — a stateless JOIN of an external traceability matrix (`gate-trace-matrix/v0`, read via `--trace-json`) against the audit-test emission's `runs[]`, resolving each requirement to mutation-proven/unverified/hollow/not-covered; it is appended to `entries` AFTER the gate decision so it is never itself a decision input (`gatePredicate.inputs` never contains a `business-risk` row) — additive only, no shape change to `resourceDescriptor` or existing entries. Backward-compatible with v0.7 in SHAPE (a bundle that never uses `business-risk` still validates identically), but NOT in schemaVersion: `validateBundle` hard-rejects any off-version `schemaVersion`, so a v0.7 bundle (signed or not) must be regenerated under v0.8. Execution evidence = Playwright JSON and/or a Cypress Module API result (added additively per contract Q1: `stage` is a free string, so a new framework needs no schema change or version bump); no numeric confidence. audit-test rides OPAQUE (Markdown inline, caps at canary), PARSED (verdict.result+label — the B→A graduation, TzolkinB/skills#49; PASSED+confirmed unlocks ship), or REJECTED (verdict.rejected+reason — a malformed/inconsistent emission, distinct from absent). Extensibility = versioned predicateType URIs + ignore-unrecognized + per-entry annotations.

subject.description: The bundle's content-addressed subjects (contract Q4): always the `pr-head` git-commit subject, plus one sha256-digest subject per ingested input file (TzolkinB/skills#139) — swap an input's bytes and its digest, and so its subject, changes. Digests are lowercase hex strings living here, never in the gate predicate (honesty guard #3 is unaffected). Per-ENTRY subjects (named `entry:<stage>`) appear only inside a signed bundle's `dsseEnvelope` payload, not here at the bundle's own top-level `subject` — they are computed at sign/verify time from `bundle.entries` (TzolkinB/skills#158, ADR-0040), never stored redundantly on the bundle itself.

dsseEnvelope.description: OPTIONAL (TzolkinB/skills#141, ADR-0037 §1; widened TzolkinB/skills#158, ADR-0040). A DSSE envelope — https://github.com/secure-systems-lab/dsse — self-signing this bundle: `payload` is base64 of the CANONICALIZED (recursive key-sort, no JCS) `{_type, predicateType, subject, predicate, producedOn, schemaVersion}`, where `subject` is reconstructed from THIS bundle's `subject` PLUS one sha256 digest per parsed evidence entry, and `predicate` is the `gate` entry's predicate; the signature is over the DSSE pre-authentication encoding, not the raw payload bytes. Absent by default (unsigned bundles are unaffected, honest ceiling stays 'in-toto-shaped, not signed'). Self-signed ed25519 proves integrity + continuity, never third-party identity — not Sigstore.

payload.description: base64 of the serialized signed Statement

keyid.description: sha256 of the ed25519 public key (SPKI/DER)

sig.description: base64 ed25519 signature over the DSSE PAE

producer.description: SLSA builder/metadata — who produced this evidence and when.

statement.description: An in-toto-shaped Statement (ADR-0032) carrying one stage's evidence — kept readable, never itself DSSE/base64-wrapped (that would falsely imply the stage's own producer signed it, ADR-0037 §1). Only the bundle's own gate entry's `predicate` is ever signed as a PREDICATE; a non-gate entry may be bound into the bundle-level `dsseEnvelope` only as a content-addressed SUBJECT (TzolkinB/skills#158, ADR-0040) — integrity, never endorsement.

evidencePredicate.description: A stage's evidence. `stage` is a data field (contract Q1), so new stages need no schema change.

rejected.description: audit-test only (v0.7): a malformed/internally-inconsistent audit-test-json emission was received and discarded — distinct from an opaque or absent audit-test. Carries no result/label/metrics.

reason.description: A short, fixed diagnostic string alongside `rejected` — never producer-controlled prose (honesty guard #1).

verdict.comment: verdict.confidence is CUT in v0 (contract Q6). Its arrival is the signal Gate has earned a number — it requires a schemaVersion bump.

gatePredicate.description: The derived gate decision (gate-function spec v0, LOCKED — #103). Honesty guard #3: additionalProperties:false and NO numeric field anywhere — a validator rejects a smuggled number, so re-adding confidence forces a schemaVersion bump.

businessRiskPredicate.description: The business-risk coverage JOIN (TzolkinB/skills#199, ADR-0045) — resolves each FULL/PARTIAL requirement in a `gate-trace-matrix/v0` input against an audit-test emission's `runs[]`. Informational only: this predicate is never referenced by `gatePredicate.inputs` and never affects `decision` (honesty guard #1 extends here — a join over presence + credibility evidence is still not itself a ship input). Either the `rejected` branch (malformed/inconsistent `--trace-json`, distinct from absent) or the `rollup` branch is present, never both.

reason.description: A short, fixed diagnostic string alongside `rejected` — never producer-controlled prose.

matrixProducer.description: informational passthrough of the trace-matrix's own `producer` field

matrixGateStatus.description: informational passthrough of the trace-matrix's own categorical gate (e.g. TEA `trace`'s PASS/CONCERNS/FAIL/WAIVED) — never read to derive this predicate's own rollup.

hasRunTrace.description: false when the paired audit-test emission carried no `runs[]` (or none at all) — every `rows[].state` other than `not-covered` is then `unverified` by construction, never a stronger claim.
